memoryRule: attention only arms; departure contracts the source fragment and changes a non-local relay plus a third echo fragment
interactionRule: pointerdown or keys 1–9 attend without writing; pointerup, Enter, Space, or depart commits one departure; Delete lifts the latest; R releases
representationRupture: compound sheet, witness-knot, and single open boundary -> seventeen autonomous filled SVG polygons in a dispersed constellation
encounterRupture: dwell, two-place witness, and drawn route -> attend then depart: presence is temporary and leaving is causal
temporalRupture: negative-space and migrating-gap memory -> bounded social absence memory carried by a population of discrete fragments
mediumRupture: one or multiple SVG path bodies -> SVG polygon field with no enclosing path
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
